facts.fact: Sandy 在帐篷外的沼泽泥地与空瓶间醒来，一只后腿站立、戴礼帽穿马甲拄手杖的金眼狐狸居高临下地质问。
facts.anchor: Now Sandy was on the ground outside the tent, sprawled in the bog mud and lying among the empty glass bottles. A fox towered above them, standing on its hind legs, with disdain in its golden eyes. It wore a top hat and a waistcoat, and it leaned upon a cane.

facts.fact: 狐狸进帐篷把 George 拖出来，一手挥着已破裂的 Hot Snot 唱片当众示众。
facts.anchor: When the fox emerged, it was dragging George by her wrist, and it fixed Sandy with a smug glare. It held the cracked Hot Snot record in its other hand, waving it about over its head.

facts.fact: George 捶打狐狸胸口并宣布根本不信 Round Robin，狐狸随即以「撒谎者」的名义威胁。
facts.anchor: “Bugger Round Robin!” George pounded the fox on its chest with her free hand. “It’s all rubbish! I don’t even believe in Round Robin!”

facts.fact: Sandy 把胆汁和麋鹿血喷满狐狸的体面礼服，狐狸暴怒松手，George 趁机挥拳，两人得以逃脱。
facts.anchor: Sandy felt their gorge rising, their shoulders heaved, and suddenly a spray of bile and elk’s blood exploded from their mouth and all over the fox’s dapper suit.

facts.fact: 逃入沼泽时 Sandy 在心里以空前虔诚默念化兔咒语，双脚深陷泥沼难以脱身。
facts.anchor: With sighing and sorrow and meckle care, I go forth in the form of a hare. And I go forth in the devil’s name, e’er that I come back again.

facts.fact: 追兵主力过后，第十三个掉队者戴刺猬头套、穿考究蓝西装，在溪流中停住嗅探，随即扑向 Sandy 藏身的树根洞。
facts.anchor: That was when a final straggler staggered by. Lucky number thirteen, by Sandy’s count. The straggler wore a hedgehog head and a posh blue blazer.

facts.fact: Sandy 用石头砸中刺猬面罩者的脸；听出对方哭声耳熟后放下石头，认出是 Percival，后者哭供是 Prudence 指使。
facts.anchor: Sandy took the stone and smash smash SMASHED it against the straggler’s hedgehog face until it fell back, shrieking and bloody.

facts.fact: 雾中浮出前向双眼如弹珠的人形暗影，Percival 匍匐哀号求饶；Sandy 喝令其离开后身影消失，章末 Sandy 意识到能号令精灵者才是真女巫。
facts.anchor: A shape hovered in the fog, just at the edge of visibility, a dark specter in the vague form of a human, its edges blurred by the haze. It had widely spaced but front-facing eyes gleaming in its head like marbles.
